title: Finite etale algebras over a henselian local ring and over its residue field
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Call a ring map $A\to S$ *finite etale* if $S$ is a finitely generated $A$-module and the induced morphism $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then the functor $S\mapsto S/\mathfrak mS=S\otimes_R\kappa$, from the category of finite etale $R$-algebras (morphisms: $R$-algebra homomorphisms) to the category of finite etale $\kappa$-algebras (morphisms: $\kappa$-algebra homomorphisms), is an equivalence of categories. In particular (essential surjectivity) for every finite etale $\kappa$-algebra $\overline S$ there are a finite etale $R$-algebra $S$ and an isomorphism of $\kappa$-algebras $S/\mathfrak mS\cong\overline S$.

proof.text: Reduction is bijective on each morphism set by [lem-weil-pbc-henselian-finite-etale-map-bijective], the assembly of original steps 1-7. Install Full and Faithful from its surjective and injective components.

Decompose a finite etale residue algebra into a finite product of finite separable fields by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-over-field-product]. Lift each field using [lem-weil-pbc-henselian-finite-etale-field-lift]. The product is finite etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-finite-product]. Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight identifies its reduction with the product of the reductions; AlgEquiv.piCongrRight combines the factor isomorphisms and the inverse decomposition isomorphism identifies the result with the original residue algebra. This also covers the empty product.
Install EssSurj from the constructed witnesses and construct Functor.IsEquivalence from Full, Faithful, EssSurj. Pair it with the same essential-surjectivity witnesses.
